## About

Sylva is a computer-science graduate and systems engineer building PAI
(Personal Artificial Intelligence infrastructure) — a Jarvis-class personal
agent runtime — alongside early-signal tech-watch tooling. Projects here span
FastAPI/Python backends, Next.js frontends, and infrastructure-as-code.
